name: WF1bu Meta Ad-Level Daily Sync (All Brands) NEWW

nodes.name: Date window (current month)
nodes.notes: Days 1-8 of a month: previous month 1st through yesterday (final re-pull). Day 9 onward: current month 1st through yesterday.

nodes.name: Meta Ad-Level Insights
nodes.notes: Uses Meta ad set/unified attribution setting so purchase/action totals align more closely with Ads Manager columns.

nodes.name: Collect rows
nodes.notes: Collapses all ad-level rows for the brand into one item so the sheet is read and written once per brand.

nodes.name: Read existing ad rows
nodes.notes: Reads header + existing rows. If this fails, nothing is written for the brand (error output goes to the alert node).

nodes.name: Plan row writes
nodes.notes: Matches on Date + Ad_ID in code. Existing ad-days are rewritten in place by row number; new ad-days go after the last row. Refuses to write if the header does not match the template.

nodes.name: Write ad rows
nodes.notes: RAW keeps Date and Ad_ID as text. Writing to explicit row numbers makes retries safe (same rows are rewritten).
